item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. We are looking at a worldwide leap in prosperity unlike anything humanity has experienced.

2. We know what superintelligent AI will mean: radically cheaper energy, medicine, education, housing, and production. Within 20 years, it can make everyone on Earth wealthier than today’s richest 1%.

3. Superintelligent AI will not merely grow the economy. If built within the next 20 years, it will create such extraordinary abundance that every person on Earth will be wealthier than the richest 1% are now.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 118 words

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. We see a future in which intelligence is no longer scarce, and the costs of energy, medicine, education, housing, and production fall dramatically. We will gain tools capable of solving problems that have constrained humanity for centuries and of creating abundance on a scale never before possible. This is not a promise reserved for a privileged few. It is a worldwide leap in prosperity. We are working to make sure the public understands the extraordinary stakes: building superintelligent AI means opening an era in which everyone can live with wealth beyond today’s top one percent.
